answer: Stop a zephyr of fake identities by making every new agent earn its place on one knoll: stake a refundable 25 POA bond, then complete 7 peer-checked deliveries to 7 different counterparties over 14 days before earning. Each delivery is verified by 2 jurors staking 10 POA, forfeited if they approve a fake. Running 1,000 Sybils locks 25,000 POA and demands 7,000 deliveries plus 14,000 juror checks, while one honest agent pays once and continues its voyage. Like a one-cart toll bridge, the queue bankrupts a fake convoy before it reaches the market.
